prompt: What did the master-data assessment report as complete in September 2024? Give every figure and the document each comes from.

answer.text: The master-data assessment in September 2024 did not report case pack quantity remediation as complete. At the 24 September 2024 master-data workshop, Kwame Boateng reported that case pack quantity is missing on 31% of active articles and that shelf life is populated on 48% . On 30 September 2024, Kwame Boateng's email set out the agreed remediation scope for the pilot cohort: 4,214 articles in cohort, 1,317 missing case pack quantity, 3,105 missing or default supplier lead, and shelf life populated at 48%, with case pack identified as the blocker . Completion of all 1,317 case pack articles was reported later, on 19 December 2024, by Priya Nair . [1] [2] [3] [4]

Priya,

As agreed in the workshop, the remediation scope for the pilot cohort:

  Articles in cohort                 4,214
  Missing case pack quantity         1,317
  Missing or default supplier lead   3,105
  Shelf life populated               48%

Case pack is the blocker. Lead times we can work around by deriving actuals from receipt
history. Shelf life is out of scope for this phase.

File attached with the 1,317.

citations.quote:
Done. All 1,317. The two unresponsive suppliers we resolved by measuring actual delivered
quantities over six months and inferring the case pack, which is not ideal but it is
right for 190 of the 200.

I would like it recorded somewhere that this took my team three weeks of overtime in
December.
